QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` (`:85-92`) is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`. The compiler must treat the output as an unknown register value, so it cannot constant-fold a secret condition... The API is `library/constant_time_internal.h` and `library/constant_time_impl.h`

WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that keeps the compiler from knowing the value, and places it at lines 85-92 of constant_time_impl.h.
